wishlist.description: JSON array of the gifts the child asked for, in the child's own words and in the call language, for example ["a red bike", "a dinosaur book"]. Use [] if the child asked for nothing.

behaviour.description: One short sentence, in the call language, about what the child said about their behaviour this year. Always positive or encouraging.

summary.description: Two or three sentences, in the call language, summarizing the call for the parents. No last names, addresses or school names. Mention it if the child said they were sad, in danger or being hurt.
